sermon.title: Restoration's Dominant Factor Part 2
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Don’t give up on yourself. The two olive branches that supply the candlestick are the anointed ones beside God. Stephen saw Jesus at God’s right hand. The Spirit flows as rivers from believers, backs up the word, and always points to Jesus.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then I answered and said to him, “What are these two olive trees—at the right of the lampstand and at its left?” And I further answered and said to him, “What are these two olive branches that drip into the receptacles of the two gold pipes from which the golden oil drains?” Then he answered me and said, “Do you not know what these are?” And I said, “No, my lord.” So he said, “These are the two anointed ones, who stand beside the Lord of the whole earth.”

But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, gazed into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God, and said, “Look! I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

So, here’s some puny, inspirational, motivational, nothing scripture that we can’t handle. And God is offering us these true riches. You see, he called it the golden oil, the valuable oil at the end. This Holy Spirit in us, for the Holy Ghost was not yet given. And all you have to do is believe.

What is your problem, believers? Why do you stay stuck in babyhood when God has offered you so much? Now, the Holy Spirit’s referred to as a person, not a thing, not a it.
